findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses, get_business, read_event_details, get_import_format, check_import_file · Private data: search_businesses, quote_event, get_public_org, read_event_details, get_import_format, check_import_file, search_places, get_place · Public sink: get_business, read_event_details, check_import_file, request_booking, request_sponsorship, send_feedback · Destructive: read_event_details, get_import_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses, get_business, read_event_details, get_import_format, check_import_file · Private data: search_businesses, quote_event, get_public_org, read_event_details, get_import_format, check_import_file, search_places, get_place · Public sink: get_business, read_event_details, check_import_file, request_booking, request_sponsorship, send_feedback · Destructive: read_event_details, get_import_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
